name: 21104-longdecode-qwen32b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B. Ungated, and already in the local HF cache. ~65 GB of bf16 safetensors.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense bf16 (no MoE, no MLA), GQA; the rest is readable off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 128 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure: exactly 500 prompt tokens in and exactly 2000 generated tokens out, no variance on either. `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true`, so a request generates exactly 2000 tokens and the run takes a fixed number of decode steps.
purpose: A long-form report writer on a 32-billion-parameter model, serving eight concurrent users short prompts and 2000-token answers across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.10.post1. Every key here is a CLI flag of that version; anything absent is stock,
# including CUDA graph capture -- leave that on, a run with graphs disabled measures something else.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-32B
tp-size: 8

# Pinned rather than left to autodetect, so a driver or capability difference cannot silently
# select a different attention backend.
attention-backend: fa3
